sources.source: Fu et al., Do More Agents Help? Controlled and Protocol-Aligned Evaluation of LLM Agent Workflows, arXiv:2606.05670
sources.projection: Fair agent comparison benefits from a normalized execution substrate with shared benchmark loader, tool access, answer contract, usage accounting, and trajectory logging.
rakl_mapping: reference runtime and future provider adapters should normalize task packets and execution receipts
agent count or orchestration complexity is not assumed to improve scientific quality
sources.novelty_effect: normalized execution/accounting is prior art; RAKL runtime is infrastructure rather than headline novelty

sources.projection: Graph state can be saved as checkpoints, including pending writes that support failure recovery without rerunning completed work.
rakl_mapping: META_N019 durable research execution should compare checkpoint/write-ahead designs rather than invent persistence from scratch
model state and workflow state should remain separate
sources.novelty_effect: durable checkpointed agent execution is prior art

sources.source: Wu et al., Agent-Based Software Artifact Evaluation, arXiv:2602.02235
sources.projection: Automated artifact evaluation must perceive execution state, stabilize execution environments, plan dependency-aware commands, and recover from execution errors.
rakl_mapping: release conformance requires executable artifact instructions and diagnostics, not prose-only claims
future artifact-evaluation lane should test clean environment construction and error localization
sources.novelty_effect: automated artifact execution/recovery is prior art

sources.source: Baek and Pradel, Artisan: Agentic Artifact Evaluation, arXiv:2602.10046
sources.projection: Research reproduction can be represented as independently executable scripts and judged with execution-based artifact benchmarks.
rakl_mapping: RAKL publication artifacts should be independently runnable without the authoring agent
artifact conformance should be execution-based and known-answer grounded
sources.novelty_effect: independently executable artifact reproduction is prior art

sources.source: Python Packaging User Guide, pyproject.toml and entry-points specifications
sources.projection: Installed distributions may expose console commands through declared entry points; project.scripts maps to console_scripts.
rakl_mapping: a future protected-input change may add a console entry point after evaluator-aware re-freezing
Round 022 intentionally uses python -m rakl to avoid changing protected pyproject configuration
sources.novelty_effect: CLI entry points and packaging conventions are standards/prior art

sources.projection: Experiment logging benefits from structured records, raw archives, anomaly capture, and explicit missing/ambiguous fields rather than guessed values.
rakl_mapping: future execution receipts should preserve raw outputs and unknown fields
diagnostic logs must not repair or invent scientific evidence
sources.novelty_effect: structured experiment logging/raw archival is established practice
